label: Task-16
title: Add View Graph button to node detail header
description:
Add a button in node-detail view to open the graph visualization centered on the current node.

## Requirements
- Add 'View Graph' button in node-detail header (near Edit/Delete)
- Button opens graph-viewer component
- Pass current node's type and label as root
- Default depth of 1 (show immediate connections)

## Implementation
```javascript
// In node-detail.js header
<button class="btn-graph" @click="openGraphView">
    <icon>graph</icon> View Graph
</button>

openGraphView() {
    this.events.emit('show-graph-viewer', {
        rootType: this.node.node_type,
        rootLabel: this.node.label,
        depth: 1
    });
}
```

## Navigation Options
1. Open as modal/overlay on current view
2. Navigate to dedicated graph page with back button
3. Open in right sidebar panel

## Depends On
- Task-15 (graph-viewer component must exist)
